prompt:
A high-fidelity WEBSITE DESIGN COMP: a flat, screen-accurate rendering of a desktop web page at 1440px wide, viewed perfectly straight-on. No device frame, no browser chrome, no mouse cursor, no perspective tilt, no drop shadow around the page. This is a UI LAYOUT, not an illustration and not a poster: every region is a real page region with real typography at real, readable sizes and real alignment to a grid. Landscape 16:10, filling the frame edge to edge.

VISUAL WORLD — fixed, do not reinterpret, do not add to:
- Ground: rain-black, #07090D to #0D1420. Wet, deep, matte.
- Primary accent: one scarlet, #E6202C. This is the only accent on interface elements: the primary button, key rules, active ticks.
- Signage-only colours: magenta #FF2F7F and cyan #26D4EC. These appear ONLY inside the photographic city imagery as lit signs and reflections. They NEVER touch interface text, buttons, tables, or labels.
- Text: off-white #E8E6E1 for primary, concrete grey #7A8089 for secondary.
- Display type: very condensed, heavy, uppercase industrial signage lettering, tight tracking, slightly screen-printed / grainy edges.
- Label and body type: a technical monospace, small, uppercase for labels, wide letter-spacing.
- Materials: wet asphalt reflections, dense stacked vertical signage, hazard chevron stripes in off-white and black, riveted metal plates, hairline rules.

THE CRITICAL RULE OF THIS DESIGN: the neon and the glow live ONLY in the photographic imagery. Every region that carries data, specs, tables, or running text is a CALM, matte, near-black plate with crisp off-white type and at most a scarlet hairline or tick. There is no glow, no bloom, and no gradient haze behind any text. A spec table in this design is quiet and perfectly legible.
PAGE STRUCTURE, top to bottom — build the layout in exactly this order and these proportions:

1. THIN TOP BAR, about 4% of the height. Rain-black. Far left: a small scarlet geometric mark plus the wordmark SHADOWORD in condensed uppercase, letter-spaced. Far right, small mono uppercase: LINUX FIRST, OFFLINE BY DEFAULT, and a scarlet outlined button reading READ THE SOURCE.

2. HERO, about 62% of the height. This hero is TYPE-LED, not image-led: the headline is treated as an enormous illuminated street sign and it is the dominant element on the page.
   The ground is rain-black. Flanking the far left edge and the far right edge, two narrow vertical columns of dense stacked lit signage panels in magenta and cyan, like the two walls of a street, each column no more than 12% of the width, dim and out of focus so they frame without competing.
   Filling the entire centre, the headline in colossal condensed heavy uppercase, three stacked lines, tightly leaded, centre-aligned, occupying roughly 70% of the width and most of the hero height:
   SPEECH TO TEXT
   THAT NEVER LEAVES
   YOUR MACHINE
   The first two lines are off-white; the words NEVER LEAVES are rendered in scarlet as the lit part of the sign. The lettering has a slightly screen-printed, grainy edge and a faint scarlet edge-light where it faces the viewer, but NO soft bloom halo.
   Beneath the headline, its mirrored reflection in wet black asphalt, compressed and broken into vertical streaks, fading out — occupying the bottom 20% of the hero.
   Centred over that reflection: one line of grey mono uppercase reading LINUX FIRST. LOCAL WHISPER BY DEFAULT. YOU CHOOSE THE MODEL AND THE SILICON., and below it a solid scarlet rectangular button with off-white mono uppercase reading READ THE SOURCE.

3. TICKER STRIP, about 6% of the height, full width, a calm matte near-black band bounded by scarlet hairlines top and bottom, NO glow. A single horizontal row of mono uppercase items divided by thin vertical rules, evenly spaced: OFF, LOCAL, REMOTE, then PUSH TO TALK F2, then WAYLAND AND X11, then CPU, VULKAN, CUDA. LOCAL carries a small lit scarlet square.

4. SECOND FOLD BEGINS, the bottom 28%, cropped by the frame edge. A DENSE calm matte near-black specification board, no imagery, no glow, built like an airport departure board rendered in quiet mono type: many tightly stacked hairline-divided rows in two side-by-side panels.
   LEFT PANEL, headed by a small scarlet mono label reading ENDPOINTS, rows of off-white mono with the method in grey and the path in off-white: GET /HEALTH, GET /V1/STATUS, GET /V1/CONFIG, POST /V1/TRANSCRIBE-WAV, GET /V1/STREAM, GET /V1/MODELS.
   RIGHT PANEL, headed by a small scarlet mono label reading STREAM PROTOCOL, rows of off-white mono each prefixed by a small scarlet or grey directional tick: START, then BINARY OPUS PACKETS, then COMMITSEGMENT, then PARTIAL, then FINISH, then DONE.
   Both panels are perfectly quiet, crisp and legible — the deliberate opposite of the lit headline above.

TEXT: render every word listed above exactly and spelled correctly. Do not invent any other words, numbers, benchmarks, latencies, prices, star counts, or testimonials anywhere in the image. Any lettering inside the flanking city signage is decorative and must not read as English claims.

DO NOT: add a browser window, tab bar, URL bar, or window controls. Do not tilt or angle the page. Do not add a photographic city scene behind the headline — the centre of the hero is type on a near-black ground, not a cityscape. Do not put glow, bloom, or coloured haze behind any text in the ticker strip or the specification board. Do not let magenta or cyan appear on any button, label, row, or rule.
